description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). You are an exercise physiologist at the National Sports Performance Institute preparing a body composition monitoring program for a collegiate wrestler during their off-season weight management phase.

A program specification document has been placed at /home/ga/Documents/body_comp_program.txt with all details.

Read the document and complete ALL tasks specified in it:
1. Log the athlete's historical weigh-in data (5 body weight entries on specific dates)
2. Create the specified measurement categories and log baseline measurements
3. Create the specified workout routine with training days and add the listed exercises to each day
4. Set up the nutrition plan with the specified macronutrient goals

All values, dates, and names must match the program document exactly.
